items.title: Quantum gates set speed record at 6.8 nanoseconds with over 99.98% accuracy
items.summary: Researchers from Jülich, Aachen and Cologne have performed a quantum operation on a qubit in just 6.8 nanoseconds—with more than 99.98% accuracy. Such operations typically take several tens of nanoseconds in superconducting quantum computers. The paper was published in Nature Communications.

items.summary: The war on Ukraine is changing Russia far beyond the immediate effects of the conflict.

items.title: Embedded enzymes help plastics break down faster in the deep sea
items.summary: Scientists have developed a way for certain types of compostable plastic to break down much faster in marine environments, from shallow coastal waters to the deep sea. The breakthrough comes from tiny enzymes embedded in the plastic that help degrade it from within.

items.summary: A new study led by Kumar Venkitanarayanan, dean of the College of Agriculture, Health and Natural Resources (CAHNR), has shown that plant-based antimicrobials are a promising path toward controlling antibiotic resistance in foodborne pathogens. items.title: First light: Hera resolves two asteroids instead of one
items.summary: The European Space Agency's Hera spacecraft for planetary defense has resolved its two target asteroids separately for the first time, revealing the binary nature of the Didymos system, currently some 197 million km (122 million miles) away from Earth.

items.title: Bonobo females hunt more than males, decade-long study reveals
items.summary: In humans, hunting is considered a man's endeavor. But in one of our closest living relatives, hunting is primarily women's business.

items.summary: To prevent the spread of dangerous diseases by mosquitoes, scientists have long studied their reproductive mechanisms to control their population sizes.

items.summary: Adelaide University quantum engineers have found a new way to improve some of the world's most sensitive sensors of electromagnetic fields, a breakthrough that could help advance brain imaging, medical diagnostics, communications technology and next-generation quantum devices.
